objects.name: Attack Flow
objects.description: Extends STIX 2.1 with features to create Attack Flows.

objects.name: Detection technique coverage: windows-sql-server-extended-procedure-dll-loading-hunt
objects.description: This analytic detects when SQL Server loads DLLs to execute extended stored procedures. This is particularly important for security monitoring as it indicates the first-time use or version changes of potentially dangerous procedures like xp_cmdshell, sp_OACreate, and others. While this is a legitimate operation, adversaries may abuse these procedures for execution, discovery, or privilege escalation.
